format_help_stdout:
One of the formats
stl -- STL 3D-printing format [Write-only]
The STereoLithography format developed by 3D Systems

Write Options, e.g. -xc
  p <radius> radius for probe particle (default 0.0 A)
  s <scale> scale-factor for VDW radius and bond radius/spacing (default 1.0)
  c add CPK colours
  b draw bonds
General options,
  --bond-radius <radius> radius for bond visualization (default: 0.5 A)
  --bond-spacing <spacing> spacing between bond visualizations (default: 0.1 A)
  --colour-order-rgb export colours in red green blue (RGB) order (default: BGR order)


Specification at: https://www.fabbers.com/tech/STL_Format
